questions.prompt: Why distinguish adult peers from caregivers?
questions.answer: Their responsibilities and developmental needs differ.
questions.feedback: Do not generalise a peer script into parenting advice.

questions.prompt: What if the need exceeds competence?
questions.answer: State the limit and identify appropriate qualified support.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Designs responsive, bounded communication that checks the need, respects autonomy and avoids unsupported attachment labels.
scoring.transfer: Complete an attachment case critique combining relationship functions, a developmental timeline, label limitations and responsive communication. Include two rival explanations, a consent-based dialogue and a limit on the evidence. Revise after fictional feedback.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
